title: Athletic Tryout Checklist
subtitle: Capture team level, evaluation station, equipment, and exertion limit; confirm roster decision and coach handoff.
description: Athletic Tryout records team level, evaluation station, equipment, exertion limit, roster decision, and coach handoff. Athletic Tryout evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this athletic tryout stage-gated verification when staff must document team level and evaluation station. Reconcile equipment, exertion limit, roster decision, and coach handoff before the athletic tryout handoff. Use the evaluation rubric, station score sheets, equipment issue record, activity restriction notice, coach roster, selection rationale, and result message. Ask the assigned athletic tryout reviewer to confirm team level against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Athletic Tryout starting details review
sections.guidance: Capture the sport level, evaluation stations, issued equipment, exertion restriction, scorer evidence, roster decision, and coach communication.

sections.title: Athletic Tryout exception review: checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current athletic tryout facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Athletic Tryout required checks
items: Team level is identified for this record
Evaluation station matches the current request or source
Equipment is ready for point-of-use staff
Exertion limit limits or questions are resolved
Roster decision is communicated to the responsible person
Coach handoff is confirmed at handoff

blocks.label: Athletic Tryout failed or pending items

sections.title: Athletic Tryout readiness
sections.guidance: Hold athletic tryout readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Athletic Tryout reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Athletic Tryout receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
